metadata.title: Mehmet Akif Çakır — Mechatronics, Rust & Robotics
metadata.description: Mechatronics engineering student Mehmet Akif Çakır. Embedded systems, Rust, robotics and open-source projects.

hero.name: Mehmet Akif Çakır
hero.headline: Writing code for the physical world.
hero.description: I'm a mechatronics engineering student working with control systems, Rust and robotics. I turn what I learn into open, inspectable projects.
hero.kicker: From hardware to decisions. From ideas to prototypes.
hero.modelLabel: A conceptual engineering drawing of a robot arm, representing neither a real product nor a completed project.

about.title: Understand the system. Make it simpler.
about.description: I'm interested in the point where software meets sensors, motors and real-world constraints. I build small interfaces, reproducible examples and projects with clearly documented limits.

projects.title: Read the code. Follow the decisions.
projects.description: Inspectable work, with its current scope and next steps documented in each repository.
projects.recoverTickDescription: A zero-dependency Rust decision engine for embedded controllers. Deterministic transitions, bounded recovery and verified replay.
projects.openRobotKitDescription: An early foundation for reusable robotics tools, starting with a small Python motor abstraction.
projects.aiTraderPaperDescription: An offline-first research prototype with a shared simulated portfolio and explicit execution limits. Local simulation only.

skills.title: Working across disciplines.
skills.embeddedDescription: Deterministic software, microcontrollers, sensors and clear interfaces.
skills.biomedicalDescription: Anatomical layers, CAD and prototyping with FDM and SLA.
skills.cinemaDescription: Visual storytelling, generative video tools and workflow automation with n8n.
skills.evDescription: Learning and modelling cell chemistry, BMS, motor torque and durability.
skills.workshopDescription: Hardware and prototyping with Bosch Professional and Einhell platforms.
